cover_letter:
Dear STRIDE Europe Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Junior Marketeer position at STRIDE Europe, as advertised. With a proven background in digital marketing, centered on web content management, SEO, and social media coordination, I am eager to apply my skills to support your marketing team in Ghent. My experience aligns well with the opportunity to contribute to campaign execution across diverse channels and enhance brand visibility.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I am responsible for the full cycle of on-page SEO, including keyword research and content publishing, significantly improving organic visibility for client websites. I regularly build and maintain WordPress sites, managing content uploads and updates, and actively integrate social media. This hands-on experience in preparing content for websites and social platforms, coupled with tracking site performance using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush, provides a solid foundation for assisting with your digital and offline campaigns.

My organizational skills and attention to detail are demonstrated through independently managing projects such as mirook.com, where I designed a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data, and ran iterative SEO audits. I am a proactive learner, quick to adapt to new tools and platforms, and adept at managing multiple tasks—qualities that I believe will be invaluable in a fast-paced environment. Comfortable collaborating with internal teams on-site in Ghent, I bring strong written and verbal communication skills in English, alongside B1 Dutch proficiency.

I am enthusiastic about the prospect of contributing to STRIDE Europe’s initiatives, helping maintain brand consistency, and developing new strategies for engagement. My CV, attached for your review, provides further detail on my qualifications. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing this exciting opportunity.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
